question: What Are the Data Types in PLC?
body_html:
PLC data types define how each value is stored in PLC memory. The common types are BOOL, Byte, Word, INT, DINT, REAL, String, DWORD and Time, and choosing the wrong one causes overflow or scaling errors.

Data typeSizeTypical use
BOOL1 bitPush buttons, limit switches, alarms
Word16 bits, 0 to 65,535Raw analog values, registers
INT16 bits, −32,768 to +32,767Counters, scaled values
DINT32 bits, signedTotalizers, production counts
REAL32 bits, floating pointFlow, pressure, PID calculations
